title: History & Economy Through Maps - Videos
description:
Welcome to History & Economy Through Maps.

We explore major historical events and today's economic news through geography, terrain, and geopolitics.

Why did a war break out in that exact place?
How did that country rise so quickly?
What is the real story the news doesn't tell you?

When you lay history, economics, and politics over a map, the hidden structure of the world comes into view.

This is smart entertainment for curious adults: the things your textbooks never taught you.
